title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Maintain a process for approving each third party that stores or processes any of the organization's technology systems or data.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Maintain a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) or similar platform to document and inventory each third party that stores or processes any of the organization's technology systems or data.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the GRC or similar platform maintains a complete inventory of all third parties that store or process any of the organization's technology systems or data.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the GRC or similar platform documents the demographics of all third parties that store or process any of the organization's technology systems or data, such as business owner, criticality, and whether data is shared.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Ensure that the GRC or similar platform maintains a complete inventory of all data stored or processed by third parties.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Maintain consistent, appropriate, and approved contract language for each third party that stores or processes any of the organization's technology systems or data.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Ensure that third-party contract language requires any third party experiencing a significant cybersecurity event, such as a data breach, to promptly report it to the organization.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Ensure that third-party contract language includes provisions requiring all third parties to implement cybersecurity safeguards.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
category: TPR-09 Defined Mandatory and Optional Safeguards
definition: Ensure that third-party contract language requires all third parties to implement a defined set of cybersecurity safeguards and defines which safeguards are optional versus mandatory.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Ensure that each third party that stores or processes any of the organization's technology systems or data signs the agreed-upon contract terms.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Ensure that each third party that stores or processes any of the organization's technology systems or data is regularly assessed for appropriate cybersecurity safeguards, using third-party reports such as SOC 2 where appropriate.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Ensure that each third party that stores or processes any of the organization's technology systems or data is monitored for significant cybersecurity events.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Ensure that each third party that stores or processes any of the organization's technology systems or data is given an aggregate cybersecurity rating based on its criticality, implementation of appropriate cybersecurity safeguards, and occurrence of significant cybersecurity events.

title: Third-Party Management Policy
definition: Ensure that each third party that stores or processes any of the organization's technology systems or data is appropriately decommissioned when there is no longer a need for the third party to perform such services.
